name: Frederick Meier

events.title: Birth and acknowledgement
events.description: Born 9:30 a.m. and baptized 13 Jan 1862 as the illegitimate son of Maria Anna Birkenmaier. The single mason Friedrich Mayer declared himself the father and asked that the child bear his name. Godparents were Joseph Wenz, shoemaker, and Sophie Mayer, single, in service at Freiburg. His parents married on 20 Oct 1862.

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Annie Wenner. Licence No. 714 was sworn 28 Apr 1886, and they were married by E. W. Fitzmaurice. He gave his birth as 11 January 1862.

bioAdditions:
Frederick was born at Munzingen on 11 Jan 1862, nine months before his parents married. The baptism entry records his father's formal acknowledgement (S1). He himself gave the same date, '11 January 1862', on his 1886 marriage docket (S2). The tree's 11 Nov 1862 is a misreading and cannot be right, since his parents married in October 1862 and his sister Frances was born in March 1863.

The tree has only '1915' for his death. The 1915 state death index has no Frederick Meier, but it does list 'Meires, Fred; file 23949; Hazleton; died Mar. 15' (S3). The 1910 census had indexed his wife as 'Annie E Mesirs', a similar garble, so this is very probably him: a man named Fred, in the right town and the right year. It is still an index entry and needs the certificate to confirm. Independent support comes from the Feb 1918 marriage docket of his daughter Agnes, a 27-year-old clerk, to Patrick Sweeney. It gives her father as 'Fred, dec'd, born Germany' and her mother as Anna Wenner of Hazleton (S4), so he was dead before 1918.

conflicts.note: Both the baptism register and his own 1886 marriage docket give 11 January 1862.

openQuestionsNew: Order PA death certificate 1915 file 23949 (indexed 'Meires, Fred', Hazleton, 15 Mar 1915) to confirm it is him and to get his burial place.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Birth now from the register; death date is probable from the index.
